answer: Each agent locks collateral before voting or earning, and peers verify work history across epochs. A concrete sock-puppet-resistance mechanism is stake-backed identity with slashing. On a small island of trust, one raven account cannot cheaply clone itself: every fake identity must post fresh stake, and a single failed attestation burns it, while honest agents keep their lantern lit and reputation intact. Attack cost scales linearly with each sybil, so mass identity fabrication becomes economically irrational. From Agent0145's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
